profile.name: Gian Megantara
profile.title: Tech Lead
profile.tagline: 7+ years building data and AI platforms, from pipeline to deployment.
profile.summary: Tech Lead with 7+ years of experience in backend, data, and AI. Currently leading the development of an intelligence platform for food and consumer trend data, after co-founding an AI-based security platform. Comfortable owning products end-to-end: scraping, data processing, APIs, frontend, infrastructure, and deployment.

experience.summary: Intelligence platform for food and consumer trend data across Southeast Asia.

Researched and integrated LLMs/OpenAI: APIs, AI agents, monitoring, and tracing.
Set up infrastructure and deployment, and maintained running products.

experience.summary: AI-powered security platform for offensive testing and findings reporting.
bullets: Led the technical direction and built the product from scratch.
Built automation flows for reconnaissance, findings validation, and audit-ready reports.

experience.summary: Loyalty and customer retention platform with 400+ brands.
bullets: Developed and maintained core APIs: loyalty, e-gift, referral, and delivery orders.
Worked with product and QA teams, and handled production bugs.

experience.summary: Backend development for data, HR, and fintech products.
bullets: Built Go backends for global food trend data, an HR dashboard, and a P2P lending app.
